# [Product Name] — MS1 Product Requirements Document

**Version:** 1.0  
**Author:**  
**Date:**  
**Status:** Draft

---

## 1. Executive Summary
<!-- 1-2 paragraphs. State the problem, the proposed solution, the target user, and the expected business outcome. Be specific enough that someone reading only this section understands what we're building and why. -->

## 2. Problem Statement
<!-- What pain point exists? Who experiences it? How do they currently cope? What evidence do we have that this is a real problem (customer feedback, support tickets, market data)? Why is now the right time to solve it? -->

## 3. Target User
<!-- Define the primary user persona. Include: demographics, psychographics, golf habits, technology comfort level, current products they use, and what they value. Be specific enough to make design and feature decisions. -->

## 4. Feature Requirements
<!-- Prioritized table of features. Every feature needs a priority, a clear description, and whether it's hardware, software, or both. -->

| Feature | Priority | Description | HW/SW/Both | Acceptance Criteria |
|---------|----------|-------------|------------|--------------------|
| | P0 | | | |
| | P0 | | | |
| | P1 | | | |
| | P1 | | | |
| | P2 | | | |

## 5. Technical Specifications

### 5.1 Hardware
<!-- Sensors, chipsets, wireless connectivity, battery, enclosure, mechanical constraints -->

### 5.2 Software / App
<!-- App features, API requirements, BLE communication, cloud services -->

### 5.3 Firmware
<!-- On-device processing, BLE services, OTA update requirements -->

### 5.4 Integration Points
<!-- Where hardware, firmware, and software must synchronize. Define interfaces. -->

## 6. User Stories
<!-- Minimum 8 user stories covering all P0 features and key P1 features. Use format: As a [user], I want to [action] so that [outcome]. Include acceptance criteria for each. -->

## 7. Development Timeline

| Phase | Duration | Key Milestones | Dependencies |
|-------|----------|---------------|-------------|
| Concept | Weeks 1-4 | | |
| EVT | Weeks 5-16 | | |
| DVT | Weeks 17-28 | | |
| PVT | Weeks 29-38 | | |
| MP | Weeks 39+ | | |

<!-- Include software milestones aligned to hardware gates. Flag long-lead components. -->

## 8. Bill of Materials (Estimated)

| Component | Specification | Unit Cost | Lead Time | Supplier | Source Risk |
|-----------|--------------|-----------|-----------|----------|-------------|
| | | $ | weeks | | Low/Med/High |
| **Total BOM** | | **$** | | | |

**Non-BOM Costs:**
- NRE: $
- Tooling: $
- Certification (FCC/CE/IC): $
- Test fixtures: $

**Target Retail Price:** $  
**Target Margin:** %

## 9. Competitive Landscape
<!-- Top 3-5 competitors. For each: product name, price, key specs, strengths, weaknesses, and how we differentiate. -->

| Competitor | Product | Price | Key Differentiator | Our Advantage |
|------------|---------|-------|--------------------|---------------|
| | | $ | | |

## 10. Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Category | Likelihood | Impact | Score | Mitigation |
|------|----------|------------|--------|-------|------------|
| | | /5 | /5 | | |

## 11. Success Metrics
<!-- Quantifiable KPIs. How do we know this product succeeded? Include targets and measurement method. -->

| Metric | Target | Measurement Method | Timeframe |
|--------|--------|-------------------|----------|
| | | | |

## 12. Open Questions
<!-- Decisions still needed. Who owns each decision and by when. -->

| Question | Owner | Decision Deadline |
|----------|-------|------------------|
| | | |

name: Gate Review Checklist
description: Hardware/firmware/software/business readiness checklist for EVT/DVT/PVT/MP gate reviews.
content:
# Gate Review: [Gate Name] — [Product Name]

**Date:**  
**Reviewer:**  
**Gate:** EVT / DVT / PVT / MP *(select one)*  
**Recommendation:** Pass / Pass with Conditions / Fail *(select one)*

---

## Hardware Readiness

- [ ] All P0 hardware features functional
- [ ] Performance meets specification (attach test data)
- [ ] BOM finalized and all components sourced
- [ ] No single-source components without mitigation plan
- [ ] Mechanical design validated (fit, finish, durability)
- [ ] Battery life meets specification (attach test data)
- [ ] Environmental testing complete (temperature, humidity)
- [ ] Regulatory pre-scan completed (FCC/CE/IC)

## Firmware Readiness

- [ ] BLE connectivity stable (pairing, data transfer, reconnection)
- [ ] Sensor data pipeline validated against ground truth
- [ ] OTA update mechanism tested
- [ ] Power management states implemented and verified
- [ ] Error handling and recovery tested
- [ ] Firmware version management in place

## Software/App Readiness

- [ ] App connects to device reliably
- [ ] Core user flows complete and tested
- [ ] Data accuracy validated end-to-end (sensor → firmware → BLE → app → display)
- [ ] Offline behavior handled gracefully
- [ ] Analytics instrumented for key events

## Quality

- [ ] Test plan executed with results documented
- [ ] Known bugs cataloged with severity ratings
- [ ] No P0 bugs open
- [ ] P1 bugs have timeline for resolution
- [ ] User testing completed (minimum 5 users) with findings documented

## Business Readiness

- [ ] Cost targets met (BOM within budget)
- [ ] Timeline on track (or deviation explained with recovery plan)
- [ ] Competitive position validated (no major market shifts since MS1)
- [ ] Packaging and documentation in progress
- [ ] Marketing/launch plan drafted

## Open Issues

| Issue | Severity | Owner | Resolution Plan | ETA |
|-------|----------|-------|----------------|-----|
| | | | | |
